items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Claude Hopkins was down there, he's cross across, he says, could I introduce her to my friends.

ctx.x: I said "Actually I must be doing something". I said "I've been living with this woman for 15 years and she can't speak a word of English, see". So I told - I tell you who I told, told me that [ ], Claude Hopkins, when I was down at the, George Wein's festival in Nice, the second one, you know, they had that and I played the second and the third or somethin' like that, I played two times down there for George. And Claude Hopkins was down there, he's cross across, he says, could I introduce her to my friends. So…
